name: sparx — Pet Grooming (Playful)
tagline: A bright, playful template for dog groomers — book online from day one.
description: A bright, friendly dog-grooming site — a sky-teal primary, a sunny-yellow accent and a warm off-white ground on rounded, cheerful faces. Installs a working booking flow: a real menu priced by dog size (bath & brush, full groom, puppy intro, de-shed, nail trim), three groomers you book by name plus three grooming stations as bookable resources, and a $15 full-groom deposit policy. Ships as "Scrub & Wag".
